title: KhemSAR: An Open-Source Platform for OECD-Aligned QSAR Validation, Mechanistic SAR Interpretation and Bioisosteric De Novo Design
description: KhemSAR is an open-source, cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows) and trilingual (EN/ES/PT) scientific platform for QSAR/SAR modelling: multi-database bioactivity retrieval and curation, validation aligned with the five OECD principles, activity cliff and matched molecular pair analysis, feature attribution, bioisosteric de novo molecule generation, 3D ligand and receptor preparation for molecular docking, and interactive scientific tutoring. Every run writes an auditable workspace.
